summary: Five security findings block Phase 2. The focused suite passes all 90 tests. Green must correct the missing protections.
blocking_findings: RB-01 high scripts/storytime-book-pictures.ts:38-41: The render wrapper uses JSON.stringify as shell quoting. Bash still expands command substitutions inside the resulting double quotes. A render argument containing $(printf RB_SUBSTITUTION_EXECUTED) executes the substitution before CLI validation. The bounded quoting probe confirmed this expansion. Green must use an argument-preserving invocation or correct shell quoting. Add a regression test for the production wrapper.

RB-02 high src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:2056-2076,2220-2230: The capture middleware serves every file below out/ and the stage directory. It checks lexical containment only. A symlink inside either directory can expose an external file, including a credential file. The middleware also serves the ledger and raw reviews, not only assets. Vite uses the repository as its root without a narrow file allowlist. Green must restrict served files and verify physical containment before reading them.

RB-03 high src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:3449-3450,3476-3502: lineart-smoke bypasses resolveOutputPath for its directory and files. An existing smoke symlink can redirect writes outside the output root. File writes can also follow existing file symlinks and overwrite their targets. Green must validate each physical destination and use exclusive creation. Add directory-symlink and file-symlink tests.

RB-04 high src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:955-963,986-989,2877-2910,3133-3143,3165-3200: Provider errors, raw answers, and failure reasons enter persistent files without a secret check. Provider stderr becomes the ledger error on a process failure. Kimi --raw can copy any readable file into raw/ and the review JSON. A credential in these inputs therefore enters delivery evidence. Green must reject sensitive input before persistence and sanitize provider errors. Keep safe raw answers byte-identical. Add synthetic credential tests for both provider paths and failure records.

RB-05 medium src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:875-922,2672-2677,3572-3580: Only render calls assertCalibrationReady. verify --release never checks calibration. Valid candidate reviews can therefore pass release after calibration files disappear or become stale. T17 also passes the pure release verifier without calibration evidence. Green must check current calibration on the release path. Add missing, stale-rubric, and changed-source calibration cases.
nonblocking_findings: RB-06 low measure/anti-patterns.md: The required local catalog is absent. The test strategy records this gap and names the canonical fallback. The audit read that fallback.
